lock.takeBackFailed: The page is still being edited by someone else.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: You have unsaved changes on this page.

history.title: Publication history
history.hint: Each entry is a version that went live. This is not Undo.
history.empty: This page has not been published yet.
history.restoreBody: It becomes the draft. Your unsaved changes and the current draft are replaced. The live site does not change until you publish.
history.reset: Reset page to the published version
history.resetBody: Every field returns to the published version. Save the draft to keep it.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.body: The page returns to its last saved state.
